adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog.tsx` onError, `message` is built with a template literal: ``const message = `${err.data?.code}: ${t(err.message)}`;``. Template literals always produce a string, and here it will be non-empty even when `err.data?.code` is `undefined` (e.g., `'undefined: ...'`). Therefore `showToast(message || t("unable_to_add_guests"), "error")` will never use the `unable_to_add_guests` fallback, making that branch effectively unreachable and potentially displaying a misleading `'undefined: ...'` toast.
